observations.note: The invitation form asks for the invitee internal user ID ("Kutsutava kasutaja ID"), not a name or e-mail; how a supervisor learns that ID was not found in the UI.

The close wizard let the supervisor reach step 3 and press "Sulgen protsessi lõplikult" twice with the mandatory generalised title empty; only then it returned to step 2 with "Üldistatud pealkiri on puudu" (closeRawRuns[1]).
Irreversible steps ask for a second press (contract activation, sharing, sending a summary, confirming it, closing). Deliberate safeguard; recorded for the UI description.

limits: The supervisor right is a labelled synthetic fixture, not a real qualification or the admin approval path.
Meeting time, rescheduling, group supervision and leaving a process were not tested.
